Core Systems Control: Expert-level command of Microsoft FSLogix (Profile Containers, App Attach), Entra ID, conditional access, and zero-trust security architecture. Field & Pre-Sales Capability Experience: 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing pre-sales technical role (Solutions Architect, Systems Engineer, or Specialist Architect) within an enterprise software, cloud, or infrastructure organization. Prior experience in high-performance computing (HPC) or graphic-intensive VDI environments. Consultative Selling: Proven track record of leading architectural design workshops, executing successful POCs, answering RFIs/RFPs, and handling complex technical objections from DBAs, Infrastructure Architects, and CXOs. Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience / industry certifications (e.g., Nutanix NCP/NCA, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, Oracle OCP, or Microsoft SQL/PostgreSQL certifications). This role combines cloud infrastructure engineering, systems administration, production operations, deployment support, and direct customer interaction. You will help build new environments, keep live platforms healthy, troubleshoot customer-impacting issues, and improve reliability through monitoring, automation, documentation, and repeatable operating practices. This is not a traditional help desk role or a purely architectural position. It is designed for an engineer who enjoys both creating infrastructure and owning what happens after it goes live. Speria provides enterprise technology that helps the live animal protein industry use real-time information to improve operational insight and responsible production across the supply chain. What You Will Do Design, deploy, configure, and support Microsoft Azure infrastructure for customer environments. Manage Azure networking, compute, storage, identity, monitoring, security, databases, and application-hosting components within the scope of the role. Support customer onboarding, environment provisioning, implementations, go-lives, production cutovers, and post-deployment stabilization. Monitor environment health, availability, performance, capacity, and cloud cost signals; identify and drive improvement opportunities. Troubleshoot infrastructure, connectivity, database, performance, and Azure platform issues affecting live customer environments. Review logs and monitoring data, identify root causes, resolve issues independently where possible, and escalate effectively when development or other specialists are needed. Automate repetitive operational and administrative work with PowerShell. Improve alerts, monitoring coverage, runbooks, standards, documentation, and repeatable operating procedures. Work directly with customer IT teams on Azure, networking, security, connectivity, deployment, and incident-related needs. Partner across Engineering, Infrastructure, Projects, Product, Development, and customer-facing teams. Participate in occasional after-hours or weekend work when required for approved customer go-lives or production cutovers. What You Bring 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or a related technical role. Strong hands-on Microsoft Azure experience in production environments. Experience with Azure networking, compute, storage, identity, monitoring, and security. Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and automation, supported by practical examples. Windows Server and systems administration experience. Experience supporting production systems, customer-facing applications, hosted cloud environments, or B2B SaaS platforms. Strong troubleshooting, incident-response, root-cause analysis, documentation, and continuous-improvement skills. Confidence communicating in English with internal stakeholders and external customer IT teams. A proactive operating mindset focused on preventing incidents, not only reacting to them. Helpful, But Not Required Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code platform. Azure App Insights, Stackify, Redgate, SQL Monitor, or comparable monitoring and observability tools. Azure SQL, SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Databricks, Git, or CI/CD pipeline exposure. Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or similar. Experience in an MSP, consulting, implementation, or multi-customer cloud environment. Python or Bash scripting; cloud cost optimization; SOC 2 or ISO 27001 familiarity. Experience working with globally distributed teams. German language capability is a plus if aligned to the final market strategy. How Success Will Be Measured Reliable deployment and support of customer Azure environments. Successful customer onboarding, go-live, and post-deployment stabilization. Stronger EMEA cloud support coverage during European business hours. Timely, well-communicated resolution of infrastructure, networking, connectivity, and platform issues. Improved monitoring, automation, documentation, and operational repeatability. Strong collaboration with internal teams and customer IT stakeholders. Datacenter networking fabric— leaf/spine, BGP, ECMP, RoCE, congestion control, tenant traffic isolation, IPAM, switch automation. You'll partner with our networking architects on Spectrum-X-class fabrics that power multi-tenant AI workloads at line rate. Kubernetes substrate— the host clusters that run our multi-tenant control plane (Cilium CNI, Karpenter for capacity, GitOps via Flux/Argo, virtual cluster integration). You won't be the K8s app developer, but you'll be the person the K8s app developers trust to keep the floor solid. New datacenter bring-up— turn "rack lands on the floor" into "production capacity available to customers" as a repeatable, automated workflow. Day-2 operations— partner with DC field staff on hardware faults, maintenance windows, and on-call response. Be the voice of the physical layer in platform design conversations. Required What we're looking for: 8+ years in production infrastructure, with at least 3 years owning bare-metal lifecycle at scale. Strong in datacenter networking fundamentals: BGP, leaf/spine, MTU, congestion control, fabric debugging. Production Kubernetes operations experience — cluster bring-up, CNI internals, fleet upgrades. Comfort with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps. Has been on-call for a fleet of physical machines and knows what that costs. Bonus NVIDIA GPU clusters at scale (H100 / GH200 / GB200 / NVL72) — driver stack, NCCL, NVLink, GPU Operator. DPUs (NVIDIA BlueField, AMD Pensando) and offload patterns. Spectrum-X / RoCE / InfiniBand fabrics for AI workloads. Background in hyperscaler infra, AI cloud (CoreWeave / Crusoe / Lambda / Together), HFT, or HPC. Why Join Us Purposeful Hiring: You’re not here by accident, and neither is anyone else. Every teammate is handpicked with intention because who we build what matters. Builders Wanted: You’re not just riding the rocket ship, you’re building it. Your work directly shapes the trajectory of our company. Mission-Driven Work: We’re here to make a real impact. Our mission fuels everything we do. Excellence Is The Standard: High performance isn’t just encouraged, it’s the baseline. And it’s contagious. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! Compensation Groq is committed to providing competitive compensation through our Total Cash philosophy, which incorporates potential bonus value directly into base pay. These ranges are specific to candidates located in the United States. Compensation for international candidates will vary based on local market dynamics. Employees also receive a robust suite of benefits.
